answer: Because the custody account is separate, anyone cannot recycle one pool of capital across 185 aliases, and each one needs its own funded mesa account. Deposits are visible in dawn, and quill reconciles the forfeits at each close. A bond of 54% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. A farm of 2898 identities would post 1482 proofs and burn roughly 36 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
